_comment: Accepted production advisories (CI gate: scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Every entry needs advisory, package, reason, owner, expires. An expired entry fails CI.

entries.reason: Memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections. Fix is zod 4 (breaking API) across 46 files in ces-shared, ces-stamper, ces-eo, ces-ec and muster-api — scheduled as a Sprint 3 story. Exposure is bounded: muster-api parses JSON bodies with express.json() at the 100 kb default (25 mb only on the authenticated /api/plan push), and the other packages validate local files, not network input.
